name: Parallax "Sanguine" Energy Assault Rifle
description:
Manufacturer: Verified Offworld Laser Technologies
Item Type: Assault Rifle
Class: Energy (Electron)

Battery Size: 80
Rate of Fire: 200 rpm - Beam
Effective Range: 30 m

Attachments: Optics (S2), Underbarrel (S2)

With the Parallax, VOLT offers consumers a rugged assault rifle design with features like a larger-than-average battery and a unique actuator that enables the weapon to scale up into a persistent beam as it fires.

The "Sanguine" edition contrasts deep reds against a crisp gray reminiscent of emergency medical services.

warnings: quality modifier properties are indexed as tokens only, not final stats
FPS weapon damage, projectile, penetration, and range fields are joined through weapon ammoContainerRecord to magazine XML, then magazine ammoParamsRecord to FPS AmmoParams XML
DPS and projectileLifetimeTravel are derived only from proven base fields; quality modifiers such as GPP_Weapon_Damage and GPP_Weapon_FireRate are not applied
calculatedRange is retained only as a deprecated compatibility alias for projectileLifetimeTravel and must not be treated as effective or hard range
hardRange is sourced from beam zeroDamageRange; projectileLifetimeTravel remains separate ammo travel metadata
some FPS weapons have multiple fire actions; fireMode and fireRateRpm use the first fire action with a fireRate in XML order
damageDrop* fields are DamageInfo vectors; values use the active damage component, or summed components only for mixed damage types
damageDropPerMeter is stored as a decimal value, not converted to a displayed percentage
bullet impulse falloff is separate from damage falloff and is not used to calculate damage drop
adsSpread, statedRange, and old falloff max/drop range fields remain null without matching semantics
